name: Payoff words
summary: A centered display line that lands one word per beat (rise, scale, blur-in), optional accent words, clean exit. Give it a beat per word plus a 1.2 s hold.

params.cues: { at (first word), step (seconds per word, usually grid.beat), out }
params.pace: { enter, exit, stagger, accent } overrides for the PACE timings (seconds)

usage:
import * as payoff from '../blocks/payoff-words/index.mjs';
const line = payoff.create(ctx, { words: copy.payoff, cues: { at: CUE.payoff, step: grid.beat, out: CUE.payoffOut } });
changelog: v1 2026-09-26: extracted from the starter template

v2 2026-09-26: readable pacing. Transitions use PACE (entrances about 0.5 s, exits about 0.4 s, staggers about 0.14 s) with a `pace` override, cues.out means fully gone, and default cues and the demo leave time to read.
